lines.text: GTA Six is officially the most expensive entertainment product in human history -
with an estimated budget crossing TWO BILLION DOLLARS.
For comparison, Hollywood blockbusters like Avengers Endgame cost around three hundred and fifty million.
So where on Earth is all that money going?
First, over ten consecutive years of full-time development with thousands of developers.
Second, revolutionary water physics: waves and tides in Vice City are calculated in real time.
Non-playable characters have unique personalities, can remember your face, and react to your previous crimes.
Fourth, enterable buildings: over seventy percent of buildings in Vice City can be entered and explored.
And finally, a living weather engine where hurricanes can actually flood entire city streets!
Analysts predict Rockstar Games will make back the entire two billion dollars in less than twenty-four hours.
